name: arun279-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins published by Arun Krishnamurthy, starting with codex-delegate for bounded Codex jobs.

plugins.name: codex-delegate
plugins.description: Run one coding task through Codex. The Claude Code plugin includes broad PreToolUse hooks that inspect Bash, Monitor, and Workflow call text; its PermissionRequest hook is inert. The npm package ships only the standalone launcher and project documents. The launcher validates the live model pair, starts codex exec in a private process group, enforces a wall-clock deadline, reads the JSON terminal event, tears that group down, and returns the final message with reduced status. Requires macOS, /usr/bin/env with -S support, a python3 on PATH that starts with -I -S, and an installed, signed-in Codex CLI. Prompts and files Codex reads are sent to OpenAI.
